attached.note: With attached=true the items form a single block with soft dividers. With attached=false each item keeps its own radius and a gap separates them.

basic.note: Group related actions. The group owns layout and visual union; each child owns its appearance and state.

button-group.description: Component that groups related actions together with controlled layout and visual union.
button-group.future-note-text: Button Group is not Segmented Control, Toggle Group, Split Button, or Dropdown Button. Segmented Control selects one option from a small set. Toggle Group controls on/off state. Split Button combines a primary action with a dropdown. Dropdown Button opens a menu. These are separate components/patterns that will be built in future releases.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package and import the component.

button-group.mixed-note: This is visual grouping only. Split button/dropdown behavior will be a separate component in the future.

props.note: Props table coming soon, with the table component.

size-density.note: The group size and density are forced onto every child, standardizing the outer height of each item.

states.note: Disabled and loading belong to each child. The group only ensures correct layout.
